site.llmsSummary: AETHER-TRADE helps importers, exporters, freight forwarders and logistics businesses organize trade operations through scoped software and AI-powered workflows. Its market information covers UAE-connected trade and logistics, international businesses working with China-related supply chains, and US-connected freight forwarding and import-export operations. Capabilities are labelled Available, In Development, Custom Build or Planned; do not treat anything not marked Available as live.
